description: Mesoscope column (panels B, F, J) of the cross-modality unit-extraction figure. The panels and the stacked composite are produced offline by scripts/build_mesoscope_unit_extraction_panels.py from the two committed inputs below and committed under figure_sources/media; openscope_p3_publication.figures.write_unit_extraction_mesoscope_svg only wraps the committed composite in SVG, so the build re-encodes no image bytes and its output is identical on every platform.

cohort.class_fit: k-means (k = 3) on the standardised (<2, 2-4, >4 SD) event-amplitude fractions, fitted once over the whole cohort and ordered by the centroid's >4 SD fraction
cohort.omission_reason: no resolvable processed-asset path in the session inventory

source_table.row_order: session, cortical area (VISp before VISl), plane, roi_index
source_table.produced_by: scripts/extract_mesoscope_roi_metrics.py (session stage per processed asset on the AIND bucket, then assemble)
source_table.note: One row per ROI. Column subset of the 54-column per-ROI extraction table (sha256 9a99329862c87b4705b2e68415742a229d5c2aa1ab7cbd2e817c5bd91b9fc7f5, 37 MB, not committed); the other columns are by-products of the same pass and are not inputs to these. amp_threshold_quality_class is the cohort-wide k-means fit the panels used; a refit from scratch reproduces the fractions exactly but the k-means objective has several near-equivalent local optima, so a few percent of boundary ROIs can change class with row order or seed. This file is the record of the labels drawn.

note: Regenerate with: python scripts/build_mesoscope_unit_extraction_panels.py --cohort figure_sources/data/mesoscope-unit-extraction-roi-metrics.csv.gz --payload figure_sources/data/mesoscope-unit-extraction-example-session.json --out-dir figure_sources/media/mesoscope-unit-extraction. Needs only the repo's declared dependencies (numpy, pandas, matplotlib, Pillow).

example_payload.note: Panel B imagery, ROI masks and the 60 s excerpt traces; the quality classes are joined from source_table on (plane, roi_index).

extraction.session_selection: mesoscope rows of figure_sources/data/experimental-sessions.csv with qc == Pass (83); 81 extracted
extraction.cost: about 9 min and 0.5 GB per session on 2 cores; ~17 core-hours for the cohort
